I’m sorry, but I don’t have a function to log you out of the system. If you’re looking to end your session, you can usually do so by:

1. Clicking the “Log out” or “Sign out” button in the top‑right corner of the application.
2. Closing the browser tab or window (if the session is tied to the browser).
3. Clearing your browser cookies or cache if you want to ensure the session is fully terminated.

If you’re using a command‑line interface or a specific API, let me know and I can guide you through the appropriate command or endpoint.
